messages:
Rhya (product): FYI sales pushed hard for an "audit-ready" flow: error card -> guaranteed reconstructable trace + CSV export that maps to invoice lines. They want proposal and launch asks by EOW.
Ben (eng): TL;DR: two modes: cheap pointers written on error (tiny index), or heavy-mode where every request writes a determinist handle. Heavy-mode == steady-state cost increase.
Carmen (sre): Ops note: reconstructs are cold reads against segment store; worst-case we see huge IO. Must have per-org quotas, queueing, and an opt-in entitlement for heavy-mode.
Lena (acct): From billing/reconciliation: customers need line-item CSV that ties invoice rows -> request handles or trace ids. If we can export that reliably, legal will sign off. We're ok with a paid entitlement.
Theo (design): UX idea: keep error list compact. Add a small "audit" pill on error rows. Click opens modal: status (handle present / queued / failed), estimated cost, and download CSV if available. Show provenance + redaction note.
Rhya (product): Proposed prioritization for Q2: 1) implement error-pointer index (write-on-error) + CSV mapping export, 2) add paid always-on handle for select customers, 3) priority reconstruct queue + redaction pipeline. Launch gates: CSV export validated with finance, audit logs for every reconstruct, and canary on Dedicated.
Ben (eng): Rough estimates: pointers + index + API = 1 sprint. CSV pipeline + UI export = 1 sprint. Always-on handle ingestion change = 2 sprints infra. Priority reconstruct + redaction = 2 sprints + spike to validate 30s SLA. Need to budget for backfill work.
Carmen (sre): Ops SLO suggestions for canary: 90% reconstruct < 60s for paid tenant; default best-effort for non-paid. Runbook: job queue, per-org concurrency cap (default 3), alert on reconstruct cost >2x baseline, immutable audit entries.
Lena (acct): Pricing model idea: free pointer + CSV for basic, $X/mo per-tenant for guaranteed handles, and per-reconstruct credits for on-demand exports. Legal needs explicit export/redaction clauses.
Ben (eng): Implementation note: handle design = short determinist hash (tenant + request id) stored in compact index. Reconstruct tries segments -> if missing return audited failure. Cache recent reconstructions for 24h.
Theo (design): Error-modal microcopy: "Full trace availability depends on your plan; reconstructs may take up to 60s and incur export credits. All exports are recorded for audits." Keep it explicit.
Rhya (product): Risks: PII leak, cost spikes, user confusion. Mitigations: redaction pipeline before export, opt-in paid gating, clear UX failure states, canary measurement.
Ben (eng): Action items: I will draft RFC with data model, API, cost model and backfill plan. Will include perf spike and sample dataset.
Carmen (sre): I'll draft ops runbook & throttles.
Lena (acct): I'll draft the export pricing options and coordinate with legal.
